text_block_list.name: Still & Alve
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(She's strong...! Alv-san...! Far, far 
stronger than back then...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(—I know. Normally... I surely... wouldn't 
stand a chance anymore... But still!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No matter what it takes— I won't give an 
inch...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: To her...!! I dedicate this...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: AaaaaahhhhhAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I scream with everything I have— Even if 
it ruins my voice... if it can shoulder 
even a fraction of the pain she feels as 
she runs through agony—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Ha... aah... aaah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh!! Ahahaha Aaaaaargh hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shout of victory—one that could be taken 
as either a roar or a booming laugh—echoed 
through the venue—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: A-As I thought... A true... monster...
choice_data_list:
(It's okay. You don't need to ask... 
Still.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having screamed all I could, my voice was 
completely gone. Instead, I clapped—to 
drown out any voices of confusion. Clapped 
so hard my skin nearly tore away—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...I'm okay. I can hear you..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Your voice... had already reached me, 
loud and clear."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Let's go. ...I need to rest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Why go that far...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's fine. It must hold value to 
you all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Still, something is definitely... off."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to burn each other up like 
that, you should let it go.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Before both of them break.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Even so... As long as we 
fuel each other's flames, at least we 
won't burn out.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds strange, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Truly—something is wrong with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Alv. ...Too bad about this 
time around—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...!? I-I know you're frustrated, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san. ...Please, tell me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't know anything. I don't 
understand at all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why must an end come to two people who 
care so deeply for each other?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Because those two... They looked so 
happy, yet..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...How pitiful...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...An end comes to everyone. No matter how 
close a bond you may share.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The two of them surely understand 
everything... and will keep running with 
all their might until the final moment 
arrives."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is not something deserving of pity.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I do not understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You're still on your journey, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"We can just learn together. —Hey, come 
on."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I brought this one along today. It seems 
she wishes to―learn from you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You... ...No, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I might not be very good at it, but I'll 
teach you properly—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"If it hurts too much, you can grab my 
shoulder, okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...That's as far as it goes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. There's something I'd 
like to talk about—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ms. Ramonu...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a relief. You all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So both of us have chosen to fall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Won't you direct... that painful love 
toward me as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: At the next Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The premier domestic 2,400-meter race to 
decide the 'strongest' of the era— the 
Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—My heart raced. Mejiro Ramonu, who 
achieved the Triple Tiara that no one in 
history ever could, with absolute and 
flawless dominance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For that throne, which for a long time 
thereafter no one could follow into for 
various reasons, Still in Love made it 
shine once more with her peerless power.
choice_data_list: (If the two of them were to clash...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That's a dream come true. As a Trainer... 
no, as someone utterly mad about racing. 
It's like a wild fantasy becoming 
reality...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Would you like to watch?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
How Ramonu-san and I... fiercely competed 
against one another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to speak, I nod desperately in 
response. My heart is aching so much I can 
hardly stand it...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: A truly... innocent heart.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. I will enter... the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Are you sure this is okay? Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you... how brightly I can shine 
on the greatest stage.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please... until then—
